item.name: Gray-Water_IBC
item.description: Camp IBC that contains used kitchen and shower water.
item.readyBeforeUse: The IBC has capacity for the task and has no visible leak.
item.readyForNextPerson: All inlets and outlets are closed when not in use. No gray water is leaking or pooled around the IBC.
item.ifNotReady: Stop showers, dishwashing, and other gray-water-producing tasks. Tell the Dominatrix. Do not let gray water reach the playa.
